Name: Complimentary Clinic Coffee
Author: TheMud
Description:
Ever started a new game and sorely missed all those speed boosts you had? Ever forgotten Pelican Town had a doctor because you never needed to go in there? Here's a cure for your woes, a coffee machine at the Clinic front counter! Interact with it to get a free cup of coffee, which your character will immediately drink! Now the Clinic can be a quick stop along your daily route so you'll have a reason to drop in and say hello to Harvey and Maru! Maybe give them a gift! Or completely ignore them, you'll be seeing them soon enough anyway when your arteries burst from too much caffeine!

Requires the latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url] (ver. 3.1.1 or later)﻿ by Spiderbuttons. (If you see the Bouncer when you use the coffee machine, you're not on the correct version.)
